recent_posts.title: CometChat Migration Guide How to Migrate from CometChat to Stream
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to migrate from CometChat to Stream for better flexibility, scalability, and customization in your chat messaging and video calling integration. Stream offers unparalleled performance, seamless UX, and a well-documented developer experience. The migration process involves exporting existing chat data from CometChat, creating a free account on Stream, and migrating the implementation of your client-side application to use Stream instead of CometChat.

recent_posts.title: Jetpack Compose: The Android Developer Roadmap
recent_posts.summary: Jetpack Compose is the future of the UI toolkit in Android development. It includes components like Compose UI, State management, Side-effects, and CompositionLocal. You can migrate from XML to Jetpack Compose using practical APIs and modular libraries. Jetpack Compose also provides mechanisms to manage side-effects and pass data through the Compose tree. Stay updated with the Android Developer Roadmap series for more information.

recent_posts.summary: Learn how to build a Discord clone using Next.js and TailwindCSS. Explore how to replicate Discord using Stream's chat, voice, and video SDKs. The project is split into multiple parts, with this article focusing on the project setup.

recent_posts.title: Build a React Native Livestreaming App: A Step-by-Step Guide
recent_posts.summary: Learn how to build a React Native livestreaming app that allows people to interact, chat, and watch events together. The tutorial covers creating a new React Native app, installing the Stream's Video SDK and peer dependencies, configuring iOS and Android specific settings, broadcasting a livestream from an iOS/Android device, rendering the host's video, and running the app on iOS and Android devices.

recent_posts.title: Build an Android and iOS Video Calling App With React Native
recent_posts.summary: This article provides a tutorial on building a feature-loaded React Native video calling app for Android and iOS. It covers prerequisites, installation of the React Native Video SDK, configuring permissions for iOS and Android, setting up home and call screens, and running the app on iOS and Android devices.

recent_posts.title: Building a Google Meet Clone In Jetpack Compose

recent_posts.title: Jigsaw Finds Reliable, Scalable Development Partner In Stream Chat
recent_posts.summary: Jigsaw, a dating app that prioritizes personality over looks, successfully transitioned from PubNub to Stream Chat to enhance its user experience. The integration improved chat stability and reliability, paving the way for future innovations.

recent_posts.title: Building Your First Android and iOS App With React Native CLI
recent_posts.summary: This post provides a step-by-step guide on building your first Android and iOS app with React Native CLI. It covers the prerequisites, installation of dependencies, setting up the development environment, and running the app on iOS and Android devices.

recent_posts.title: Twilio Programmable Video Migration Guide
recent_posts.summary: Learn about the migration from Twilio Programmable Video to Stream Video. Discover the benefits of using Stream Video for real-time communication in applications. Follow step-by-step instructions to build a calling application with Stream Video.

top_posts.summary: A live stream is multi-media digital content broadcasted by one host and transmitted to many viewers over the Internet in real-time. Facebook Live, TikTok, Twitch, and YouTube Live are some of the most popular live streaming platforms available to creators.
